heading: INT. FLOODED ORCHARD COTTAGE - KITCHEN - NIGHT

units.text: INT. FLOODED ORCHARD COTTAGE - KITCHEN - NIGHT
Rain drums on a tin roof.
Water has crept an inch under the door and pools on the flagstones.
A single candle burns on the kitchen table, beside a black rotary phone, its cord stretched taut across the room.
DETECTIVE PERPETUA LOWRY, fifties, in a drenched mackintosh, stands with the receiver at her ear.
She doesn't sit.
A cup of cold tea has been on the table so long it has grown a skin.
You came alone.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: I did.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: That was brave.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: It was cheaper than a team.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: A long pause on the line.
Rain.
A drip from the ceiling lands in the cup.
Do you know where Edmund Hale is, Detective?
units.name: CALLER

units.text: In a drawer at the county morgue.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Then you know I didn't do it.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: I know you wanted me to think so.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: She picks up a pencil and turns it between her fingers.
She studies the pooling water.
She walks, slowly, to the window and looks out at the black orchard, where bare branches thrash.
Look at the third tree from the gate.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: Perpetua doesn't move.
Go on.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: She leans closer to the glass.
Her breath fogs it.
A dark shape hangs from the third tree, swinging in the wind.
She stares.
Her shoulders drop a quarter inch.
That's a coat.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: It's his coat.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: Where is he?
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Why would I tell you? You haven't asked my name.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: You've been calling me for six nights. I've heard you breathe. I know you've been drinking.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Whisky. A decent one.
units.name: CALLER

units.text: Then you can say your name over a decent whisky.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: A pause.
The receiver crackles.
When the voice returns it is lower, tired.
Roscoe Hale. Edmund's brother.
units.name: ROSCOE

units.text: Perpetua closes her eyes.
The pencil snaps in her fist.
You buried him in the orchard.
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: I buried what was left.
units.name: ROSCOE

units.text: Why call me?
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Because someone should know where he is. And the police won't dig in the rain.
units.name: ROSCOE

units.text: She sets the broken pencil on the table.
She looks at the candle, at the cold tea, at the dark window.
Roscoe. Where are you now?
units.name: PERPETUA

units.text: Look at the gate.
units.name: ROSCOE

units.text: She turns.
In the doorway of the kitchen, silhouetted by lightning, a man's shape is standing with a phone in his hand.
Thunder.
The candle gutters out.
